name: commerce
description: A storefront handles card purchases, warehouse inventory and parcel delivery.

cases.title: Payment callback deduplication
cases.content: Payment callbacks are deduplicated by event_id with a unique database constraint. Duplicate delivery returns HTTP 204 without creating a second charge. Failed processing retries after 30 seconds.
queries: What happens if the payment provider sends the same notification twice?
Como evitamos cobrar duas vezes quando a confirmação do pagamento chega repetida?

cases.title: Cart stock reservation
cases.content: Cart inventory is reserved for 12 minutes. Expired reservations release stock using the release_stock job. Checkout verifies the reservation version before committing.
queries: When does a cart stop holding inventory and how is checkout protected?
Por quanto tempo o carrinho segura produtos e o que impede finalizar uma reserva antiga?

cases.title: Shipment address freeze
cases.content: The delivery address becomes immutable at label_created. A later correction requires cancel_label before reissuing. Orders remain blocked until carrier_ack.
queries: Can the shipping destination change after a parcel label exists?
Como corrigir o endereço depois que a etiqueta de entrega foi emitida?

distractors: Refunds require an operator review and retain their original order reference.
Discount coupons expire at midnight UTC and cannot be stacked.
Product photographs use object storage and signed upload URLs.
Warehouse counts run nightly; adjustments record operator identity.
Shipment tracking polls the carrier independently of payment callbacks.
Tax rounding uses integer cents and keeps an audit record.
Customer email changes require a confirmation link.
Purchase receipts include item totals, shipping and tax separately.

name: data-pipeline
description: A Python analytics pipeline imports events, validates records and publishes datasets.

cases.title: Late arrival processing
cases.content: The ingestion watermark tolerates 7 minutes of lateness. Later events enter late_events rather than disappearing. Backfills run with replay_mode and never advance the live watermark.
queries: What happens to delayed records and how do historical imports affect progress?
Como tratamos eventos atrasados sem bagunçar o avanço da ingestão ao reprocessar o passado?

cases.title: Malformed record quarantine
cases.content: Invalid records go to quarantine/raw with validation_code and source_offset. A reviewer must approve the corrected payload before requeue.
queries: Where do broken incoming records go and how can we trace them?
Onde ficam os registros inválidos e como descobrimos de onde vieram?

cases.title: Dataset publication transaction
cases.content: Dataset publication writes to staging first, verifies sha256, then atomically swaps current_manifest. Readers continue using the previous version if validation fails.
queries: How do readers avoid a partially published dataset?
O que impede os consumidores de ler um conjunto de dados publicado pela metade?

distractors: CSV exports escape embedded quotes and preserve UTF-8.
A dashboard aggregates daily counts after successful publication.
User permissions determine which dataset columns are visible.
Metrics include ingestion latency, errors and file sizes.
Schema evolution allows nullable columns with documented defaults.
The scheduler prevents two live imports from overlapping.
Compressed files are unpacked in an isolated temporary directory.
Retention removes archived output only after backup verification.

name: mobile-notes
description: A mobile notes application works offline and synchronizes edits across devices.

cases.title: Concurrent offline edit resolution
cases.content: Offline note conflicts use a Lamport clock and device_id as a deterministic tie-breaker. Deleted notes retain a tombstone for 21 days.
queries: How are simultaneous disconnected edits merged and deletions preserved?
Como resolvemos edições feitas sem internet em dois celulares e preservamos exclusões?

cases.title: Biometric vault key lifecycle
cases.content: Biometric unlock unwraps the vault key in Secure Enclave. After backgrounding, the plaintext key expires in 90 seconds. Recovery requires the recovery_phrase, never the biometric sample.
queries: What happens to the encryption key when the app leaves the foreground?
Como a chave fica protegida ao sair do aplicativo e como recuperamos o acesso?

cases.title: Notification privacy boundary
cases.content: Push notifications contain note_id only, never note text. The content is fetched after local unlock via fetch_after_unlock. A denied session receives HTTP 403.
queries: Can a locked phone notification reveal a private note?
A notificação de um celular bloqueado consegue expor o conteúdo de uma anotação?

distractors: Text search indexes only unlocked notes on the device.
Attachments have a configurable upload limit and local previews.
The editor preserves cursor position when rotating the screen.
Account export requires recent authentication.
Favorites are stored separately from note contents.
The accessibility layout supports large fonts.
Sync retries use exponential delays after connection failures.
Storage usage is shown separately for notes and attachments.

name: infrastructure
description: Infrastructure automation manages environment resources, releases and service credentials.

cases.title: Environment state isolation
cases.content: Infrastructure state uses a separate bucket per environment. Production obtains a DynamoDB lock before applying. CI rejects plans containing destroy_count greater than zero unless explicitly approved.
queries: What prevents a deployment from modifying the wrong environment or destroying production?
Como impedimos uma implantação de mexer no ambiente errado ou apagar recursos de produção?

cases.title: Release health rollback
cases.content: Canary rollout starts at 5 percent of traffic. A p95 latency above 800 ms for 3 minutes triggers rollback to stable_revision.
queries: When is a gradual release rolled back and where does traffic return?
Quando uma versão liberada aos poucos deve ser revertida e para onde volta o tráfego?

cases.title: Service secret rotation
cases.content: Credentials rotate every 24 hours with a 15-minute overlap. Applications read credentials via secret_mount, never environment dumps. An old lease is revoked after the overlap.
queries: How can service credentials change without interrupting running workloads?
Como trocamos credenciais sem interromper os serviços que já estão rodando?

distractors: Build artifacts are identified by immutable content digests.
Log aggregation strips authorization headers before export.
Developer preview environments are removed after branch deletion.
The load balancer performs independent readiness checks.
DNS changes are reviewed with a preview of affected records.
Resource tags identify owners and cost centers.
Nightly backups are copied into a separate account.
Monitoring alerts route to the owning service team.

name: multiplayer-game
description: A multiplayer game coordinates deterministic simulation, player input and save data.

cases.title: Prediction reconciliation window
cases.content: Network prediction retains 8 frames of rollback history. A state_digest mismatch rewinds to confirmed_tick and replays buffered input.
queries: How does the simulation correct a disagreement with the server?
Como a simulação corrige uma divergência com o servidor sem perder os comandos do jogador?

cases.title: Save file recovery
cases.content: Saving writes to save.tmp, validates CRC32, then performs atomic_replace. Startup loads save.backup if the primary file fails validation.
queries: How does the game recover if power is lost while saving?
Como recuperamos o progresso se faltar energia no meio de um salvamento?

cases.title: Controller input priority
cases.content: Controller input timestamps use monotonic_ns. When keyboard and controller conflict, last_input_device wins. Rebinding is disabled during ranked_match.
queries: What resolves competing input devices and when can controls be remapped?
Como resolvemos comandos conflitantes entre teclado e controle e quando podemos trocar as teclas?

distractors: Audio effects are pooled and obey the master volume setting.
Texture streaming uses an LRU cache for nearby scenes.
Spectators receive snapshots without controlling the match.
Achievements unlock after authoritative match results.
Chat moderation uses local rules and operator review.
The launcher verifies downloaded assets before replacing them.
Frame pacing measures rendering independently of simulation ticks.
The tutorial stores completion flags separately from ranked statistics.
